findings.location: prayer-part kesod_siach and kakatuv: tei:note type=description 'חזן' / 'ח׳' placed after the part milestones
findings.problem: This file is the canonical home of prayer:amidah/naaritzekha_venaqdishkha_kesod; its root div corresp is the canonical URN. Its speaker notes sit inside the canonical part scopes, so any transclusion of …/kesod_siach or …/kakatuv brings this edition's actor cue with it. That conflicts with the rule this package applies elsewhere: Ani, Echad, the shared parts and the Shema keep word homes free of actors. It does not cause duplication in the current outputs, because the expanded spine adds no separate Kesod rubric. The module was accepted earlier.
findings.required_fix: At minimum, move each note in front of its prayer-part milestone so part-level scopes carry no actor. Alternatively, split the file into a speaker-free word home plus a documentary wrapper that carries חזן/ח׳, and give the expanded Kesod row explicit role rubrics. If you defer this, record it.
